evidence_note: A dialogue actor template directly supports association with the mission, but does not alone prove that the character speaks or is physically present in every scene.

missions.summary_en: Read Roman's message to verify the situation.
Read Chen Qianyu's message and give her a reply.
Help Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu by going to the Ecological Research Station as promised.
Help Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu by going to the Institute of Materials Science as promised.
Help Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu by going to Fangxing Avenue as promised.
Urban Sanitation Worker Auntie Yu toasted a message. She needs the Endministrator's support.

Wuling City Sanitation Director has toasted the Endministrator. He thanks the Endmin for all the help provided during the past few days, and cordially invites the Endmin to take part in the Sanitation Technical Tournament.
Go to the Institute of Materials Science and keep taking part in the Sanitation Technical Tournament.
The Endministrator encounters a troubled Yan Ning at the Tianshi Bureau Academy and asks if anything has happened.
The Stockaders have used the Xiranite Gourds for a while. The Endministrator decides to visit Qingbo Stockade and observe the effectiveness of the devices.
Zuo Guyan toasts you on Baker and informs you that some Stockaders have disappeared. He hopes you can visit Qingbo Stockade and find out what happened, and mentions that he will be there shortly.
Wuling seems to be organizing a competition for culinary aficionados. Perlica wants to discuss competition matters with the Endministrator. Talk to her and get more details.
The Endministrator receives a message from Rossi, learning that she seemed to have something urgent and needed their help.
Having largely recovered, Gilberta sends you a message asking if you can help her out with something small. You agree to help and meet her at the appointed location.
You learn that a little girl named Carly has gone missing. Gilberta and you decide to find her.
You and Gilberta successfully retrieve the safe with the filter locked within it. You decide to inform the UWST site monitor of your finding.
Following recent events, Perlica invites you to return to Dijiang's Stasis Core to assess memory recovery progress.
That red-haired Sarkaz girl you met in the Protocol Space isn't ordinary. Follow the clues to Valley IV and track her down.
That red-haired Sarkaz girl is Laevatain, Rhodes Island's long-missing reconvener. You decide to re-enter the Protocol Space to find her and recover what was lost.
After obtaining the necessary information, you decide to return to the Stasis Core of Dijiang to once again utilize the Protocol Singularity and enter the Protocol Space in search of Laevatain.
Retrieve the package as requested by Andre and deliver it to Yvonne.
Head to the Hub Base for graffiti inspiration.
Head back to the Originium Science Park and help Yvonne finish her project

missions.title_en: A River Restless in Still Winds
'Twas One River That Gave Us Drink

missions.summary_en: Read the messages that Fiona sent you to learn about the situation.
The Endmin and Rossi decide to acquire two pieces of "treasure" that the "King" desires in exchange for the sample. The first is located in the "domain" of the "Duchess of Windbell".
The Endmin and Rossi have secured two "Treasures". Talk to the "King of Brickyland" and try to exchange the "Treasures" for the sample.
The Endmin receives a message from Mi Fu, and goes off to meet her at the Main Pillar Office.
After the preparation and training, the Endmin and Mi Fu head to the arena. There, they must defeat her three masters to save Zhuang Fangyi.
Go to the arena, join Mi Fu, and face the Grand Master in the final challenge.
Fiona the Comms Officer has sent you a request for help from Seš'qa.
Enter the abandoned facility with Camille and root out the mastermind.
A corporation under the TGCC is hosting a public welfare concert in Valley IV. You have been invited and decided to attend.
After finding the missing idol Liino, she asks you to help prepare her solo concert. Following careful consideration, you agree, and the two of you set out to find a suitable takeoff site.
After confirming the landing site, the preparations are finally complete. To move forward with promoting the solo concert, you and Liino head to the Mining Camp to figure out the next step.
Read messages from Fiona the Comms Officer to verify the situation.
This will be our first dive into this Protocol Space. Hopefully we can find our target.
Dijiang lost contact with the Hub Base, where strong Aggeloid signals were also detected. Perlica and the Endmin decide to set out early for the Hub Base to investigate.
Activating the Protocol Resonance Tower will restore power to the Hub Base. Head to the reserved location outside the base and deploy the Protocol Automation-Core.
There may be extensive repair work at the Originium Byproduct Processing Center. Go to the Core AIC Area and use AIC facilities to prepare the necessary materials.
The Landbreakers have attacked the Valley Fort. Rendezvous with the Landbreaker specialist at the Bridge Approach and go to the Valley Pass.
To save the workers caught in the attack, you must enter the Valley Fort. Head to the Valley Pass and find a way to push deeper.
The refugees in the shelter need a better place to live. Follow Soth to the open field and clear out the Landbreaker camp.
The outpost has provided temporary relief for the refugees. Enter the underground ventilation shaft to infiltrate the Landbreaker camp and advance toward the Valley Fort.
The bridge connecting the Valley Pass to the Power Plateau has been destroyed. You must search for another way.
Repair work on Dijiang has gone better than expected. Tele-protocol to Dijiang and hear Xaihi's report.
The rubble-clearing work is complete. Head to the Core AIC Area and discuss the next steps with Qin Jiangchi and Andre.
To reach the Power Plateau, you must follow the road and make your way through the Originium Science Park.
After Aleeza Collins gives you an access card, you continue to make your way to the Originium Science Park.
You try to make your way across the Originium Science Park but many paths within the Park are blocked by the Blight. You must figure a way to safely navigate through this Blighted mess.
You must head to a lab on 2F of the Research Center and find Yvonne.
Tata has regained its vigor. You decide to head to the Origin Lodespring.
You bid Yvonne farewell, and press on with Tata through the Origin Lodespring.
To counter the danger in the Origin Lodespring, you need to destroy all Ankhors and eliminate the shockwave threat.
All Ankhors have been destroyed, and the barrier before the Cradle of the Ages has vanished. Go deeper into the Cradle of the Ages and eliminate the hidden threats.
You have arrived at the shaft leading to the Power Plateau, but the path ahead is even more perilous. Perlica advises making thorough preparations before moving on.
Upon reaching the Power Plateau, you spot the Æther Test Site beneath the rift. You decide to pick up the pace toward your final destination.
You receive a radio message from Crowe, head of the Originium Power Plant. You decide to head to the coordinates he provided to assess the situation at the power plant.

You decide to help Crowe find the missing apprentices, who were tasked with retrieving equipment related to the Utjug Order. Follow Crowe's guide and begin the search within the Originium Power Plant.
To reach the Æther Test Site, you must use beacons to mark locations near the denstacks. The UWST will then provide fire support based on the coordinates and secure the area to help you move forward.
Fiona informs that preparations for heading to Wuling City are complete. She needs you to return to Dijiang for further discussions.
After falling into the limestone cave, the group is separated. Faced with a young girl named Tangtang, you decide to discuss what to do next with Chen Qianyu.
With the path now opened, Tangtang decides to go to Wuling City with you.
Your group prepares to enter Wuling City to meet with Viceroy Zhuang Fangyi, and establish cooperation.
You bid farewell to Zhuang Fangyi for now, and head to the allocated AIC site to deploy the Protocol Automation-Core.
Zhuang Fangyi invites your group to the Xiranite Central Laboratory within the Tianshi Bureau Academy of Wuling to advance technical collaboration.
Your group officially starts preparing for Xiranite production.
Tangtang invites you to help with AIC Construction at Qingbo Stockade.
Go to Qingbo Stockade and check on Tangtang's situation
Follow Mi Fu to Qingbo Stockade and look for Tangtang's whereabouts.
Reach the heart of Qingbo Stockade to uncover the truth of the Stockade uprising.
Accompany Tangtang to the Ancestral Spring and confront Ruan Yi.
Go to the Main Pillar Office and join the discussion on getting inside the Marker Stone.
Enter the Marker Stone Interiors and chase down Ardashir.
Protect the Feranmut Heart against the entities summoned by Ardashir.
After meeting with Zhuang Fangyi, you decide to act according to plan and strengthen the Tianshi Pillar Array. This will defend Wuling City against Nefarith's sudden attack.
The threat to Wuling has been neutralized. Join Zhuang Fangyi and survey the post-battle situation in the city.

missions.title_en: A Breach Starts with a Crack
missions.summary_en: Go to the Marker Stone Flats and meet with Zhuang
Follow the appointment and meet with Zhuang Fangyi at the monitoring center.

missions.title_en: Kindred Souls Who Share a Vision

missions.summary_en: Zhuang Fangyi toasts a message to the Endmin. Her Xiranite Nexus research project has made progress.
Go through the passage to reach the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.

missions.title_en: A Past Shared by the Swordmancers
missions.summary_en: You pass through the Designated Urban Area engulfed in Blight Miasma, heading to the next Sentry Base site. Arcane says the area ahead is Tanjian Hall, where many Yinglungs once lived and trained. The group heads there with her to clear the way for the Tianshi convoy.

missions.title_en: Same Old Faces in a Place Transformed
missions.summary_en: Enter the Miasma-covered area, find the rift, and use the Xiranite Nexus to contain it.
Cross through the ruins, find the rift fissure, and contain it.
Bring the Xiranite Nexus and go to the Wuling Very Large Rift with your team.
After leaving the Wuling Very Large Rift, everyone waits at the Sentry Base next to the Celestial Column for the Endmin team to return.
Give supplies to the Refugee Camp to help it develop.
Give supplies to the Refugee Camp to help it develop.
Give supplies to the Refugee Camp to help it develop.
Daniel seems to be troubled by something. You decide to talk to him to understand what bothers him.
You receive a message from Crowe. He wants to discuss the reconstruction of Valley IV.
You receive a message from Ardella. She seems to be struggling with the reconstruction.
Crowe has a request from the Reconstruction HQ.
Construction of the large geological probe nears completion. Check if things are still running smoothly at the Reconstruction HQ.
Incoming communication from the Collinses confirms their Infra-Station, currently serving as an emergency shelter, requires immediate assistance.

The Endministrator learned from Da Pan that Noffman, chief of the Infra-Station, had led a search party out. Yet none had returned, long past their due. The Endministrator resolved to set out and find him.
The refuge point came under attack by the Landbreakers, leaving chaos in their wake. To steady the faltering morale, the Endministrator resolved to make for the Infra-Station.
Fiona sent word, relaying the Valley IV Emergency Committee's gratitude to Endfield, and their concern for the missing. The Endministrator decides to find out what's going on.
Noffman has sent you a message. His friend Vera has an issue on her hands. She works at the Eco-Farm near the Infra-Station. Go there and check the situation.

missions.title_en: OD Project: Sky King Flats I
missions.summary_en: Zhuang Fangyi sends you a message. Wuling Tianshi have encountered issues at the farm complex at Sky King Flats. Go to the Sky King Flats Construction Site and assess the situation.

missions.title_en: OD Project: Sky King Flats II
missions.summary_en: Qingwu has reported an emergency at the Endfield Construction Site at Qingbo Stockade. Go to the Sky King Flats Construction Site and verify the situation.

missions.title_en: OD Project: Sky King Flats III
missions.summary_en: The farm complex is near completion. Zhuang Fangyi assigns Mi Fu to the task of final validation. Go to the Sky King Flats Construction Site and support the validation work.
Give supplies to the Cardiac Remediation Station to help it develop.
Give supplies to the Cardiac Remediation Station to help it develop.
Give supplies to the Cardiac Remediation Station to help it develop.
An operator is surrounded by Landbreakers. Go and rescue her.
The Depot Node has been unlocked. Increase the operations level for access to more features.
Zhuang Fangyi has messaged the Endministrator. She wants to talk about outpost expansions in Yinglung Pass.
Read Wei Xidong's messages to find out what happened.
Read Fiona's messages to verify the situation.
Help Vallia re-activate the main switch at the first floor of the Originium BPPC building.
Ask the UWST crew nearby about the situation.
Follow Fiona's lead and investigate the source of the SOS signal.
There is a worker loitering around the gate of the Kohl Plant. She seems rather intent to get inside.
Go to the location marked by Rosa.
Two frustrated UWST scientists are trying to look for a missing medicinal sample. You decide to help them out.
The gate is shut. Try to open it.
Assist Tianshi Fang Ze in stabilizing the anomalous rods within Wuling's Residential Area. Restore energy equilibrium and complete critical maintenance protocols.
Ask Jing Hong about disturbances in the waterways.
Talk to the suspicious guy by the pond to find out his intentions.
Help Liu Xie find the legendary toolkit hidden deep in the Watchtower Reservoir Station.
Calls of help have been heard from a faraway mass of Blight. Investigate it.
Tianshi disciple An Yu tells the Endministrator about pipe valves that need emergency repairs. The latter decides to help.
A Tianshi studying the Blightshades seems to have run into problems. He hopes the Endministrator can help.
You see a troubled Yinglung. Talk to him to learn what is going on.
Fiona tells you about an Energy Alluvium going out of control and advises you to investigate it.
Dusthair Miguel at the Worker Dorms is requesting you to collect some herbal samples for him.
Invisible Landbreaker graffiti have attracted the attention of a security officer. You decide to uncover the truth behind these cryptic messages.
Security officer Jouster who found the invisible Bonekrusher glyphs has sent you some messages. His investigation has made some progress.
The director of the Hub Base is overwhelmed with work. Perhaps you can help her out, Endministrator.
Erikssohn Trading House has news again. Read their message for more information.
Negotiations have stalled as you now have to deal with agent identity theft. You decide to further your investigations to reveal the truth behind the fraud.
The Valley IV Rebuilding Project has begun. Director Qin hopes to give you an update of her work.
Someone needs help at the Worker Dorms. You decide to investigate.
Cynthia, our AIC Research Center (AIC-RC) Manager, is missing. You must find her and ensure her safety.
You have solved many issues at the Hub Base. Time to talk to Director Qin again.
Arclight of the Hannabit Circuit is requesting help from Endfield. You decide to head to the entrance of the Valley Pass and meet up with Perlica.
You enter the cave and see several people locked up in metal cages. You must rescue them immediately.

missions.title_en: In for a Penny, In for a Pound
missions.summary_en: You find a heavily wounded warrior in a Landbreaker cage. He seems to be in need of help.
Fiona has received a distress call from the Aburrey Quarry. Go to the Quarry and assess the situation.
To reach other areas of the Aburrey Quarry, you must find a way to repair the super crane.
You successfully reach the Deep Management Post. Head in and try to find the missing UWST crew mates.
You have received messages from Fabian Collins. To learn more about the "unexpected sitch" he mentioned, you decide to meet up with him.
Raquel has escaped. You decide to meet Avywenna first.
You learn about a missing batch of Endfield medical supplies en route to the Mining Camp. You decide to go to the Mining Camp to investigate.
To rescue Molly, you decide to infiltrate and search the meteorological station.
Endmin learns about Jenner's situation from Alia, and decides to visit her at the Mining Area Clinic.
Endmin receives a message from Alia saying Jenner has once again gone missing, and decides to go to the Mining Camp.
Crowe's apprentice, Angro sends you a message. It seems they need your assistance.

You receive a message from Fiona and learn that the fleet of logistics robots deployed by the UWST at the Power Plateau has suffered a large-scale breakdown. The causes are still unknown. To get to the bottom of this issue, you decide to go to the Originium Power Plant to gather more intel.
Following Mi Fu's request, you head to the north of Qingbo Bailey to check on the watchguard.
You decide to follow the footprints westward, continuing the search for the missing people.
To find the missing Tianshi, you decide to take a bamboo raft to South Hill.
All three cores have been fixed. It seems that some changes have occurred in the Stragglers Grove.
Sounds of activity come from the south side of the Treadway, perhaps someone needs your help.
At Lifeng's request, you head to the industrial and agricultural production unit to join the Burdenbeast Care Workshop.
The Endministrator accepts Chen Qianyu's invitation and decides to visit Fangxing Avenue for a proper experience of life in Wuling.

missions.title_en: The Old Man and the Tide I
missions.summary_en: Yin Dong asks the Endministrator's team to help find his missing mentor, Tianshi Mo. Someone witnessed Tianshi Mo rushing out of Wuling when the Blight Tide surged against the city. The areas near the Maintenance Zone have been damaged by the Blight. Scan the area to find clues.

missions.title_en: The Old Man and the Tide II
missions.summary_en: Yin Dong has toasted a few messages. He intends to meet the friend who has agreed to meet Tianshi Mo.
The Endministrator's team learns of a break-in at Aunt Tian's home and decides to investigate.
Aunt Tian and Ah Zai's competition is about to start. Go to Fangxing Avenue and watch the contest.
The Endministrator's team hear cries for help near the Ancestral Spring. They decide to look for the source.
To find Du Ming, the Endmin's team decide to visit Qingbo Stockade and ask Tangtang for help.
The incident has finally ended. The Endmin's team returns to the surface to meet up with Tangtang.

missions.title_en: Seekers of the Lost Treasure I
missions.summary_en: A young self-proclaimed "Tianshi" named Piot has run into problems near the Qingbo Stockade fort. The Endministrator decides to help.

missions.title_en: Seekers of the Lost Treasure II
Seekers of the Lost Treasure III
missions.summary_en: To find the one who left the secret messages, the Endministrator's team decides to enter the "cave" mentioned in one of them.
Mi Fu asks the Endministrator to visit an underground area of the Urban Development Hall.
Go to Serenity Garden with Mi Fu and continue your investigations there.
The Endministrator's team meets Iron Boatswain below the Eternal Wall and prepare to attend the memorial service.
Mi Fu asks the Endministrator's team to come to the Urban Development Hall and help repair the Tianshi Pillar.
Zhuang Fangyi asks the Endministrator to head to the Marker Stone and help Xi Mo complete its repairs.
Catch up to the pantailbeast formed by Feranmut Heart energy, then investigate and solve the problems of the Marker Stone.
A Tianshi disciple and a watchguard are arguing about something outside the Test Area. The Endministrator's team decides to find out more.
The Type-C Tianshi Pillar has malfunctioned. The Endministrator's team decides to follow Tianshi disciple Lu Lingxiang to another control panel and check on the problem.
The Endministrator's team is just about to leave the Test Area when they notice a familiar figure near the Water Treatment Sector. Follow Lu Lingxiang to find out what is going on.
Lian Xiaowu has suddenly requested to meet the Endministrator at the Bureau of Swordmancers in Wuling City.
An Yinglung seems to be troubled with something. Go to the North Wuling Exclusion Zone to learn what is going on.
Things at North Wuling Exclusion Zone have settled down for a bit. Arcane sends you a message asking if you could help out Lifeng.
